thread:
Elaine (PM): sharing the draft PRD + SLO appendix. need to finalize latency & error budgets for launch tomorrow. quick reads pls: https://redwood.internal/prd/slo-fallbacks :eyes:
Jonas (Eng): skimmed. +1 on a 99.5% p99 target for hosted tier, but worried about tail when seq len spikes.
Maria (SRE): 99.5% p99 is OK for interactive UI but error budget calc needs to include rate-limited retries and downstream timeouts. propose 7-day window, 2% error budget.
Keiko (ML Eng): for model fallbacks we should define quality gates. fallback to distilled-v1 if toxicity score < 0.02 and perplexity delta < 5%. otherwise fail closed.
Sam (CS): a couple enterprise customers asked for 99.9% SLA. that would need Dedicated + warm pools. we should list tradeoffs in PRD.
Priya (Sales): confirm — enterprise asks are must-have for renewal in 90d. can we offer contractual SLA if they buy dedicated?
Jonas (Eng): we can, but that increases cost. suggest two paths: (A) 99.9% SLA with dedicated pools and 99.5% hosted default, or (B) 99.7% hosted with cross-region fallback. which is acceptable?
Maria (SRE): add error budget policy: auto-throttle non-critical routes when burn > 60% for 2h. notify on-call and throttle background batches.
Keiko (ML Eng): fallback policy needs an ordered list and acceptance criteria. sample policy block below:
```
fallbacks:
  - name: local-quantized
    accept_if: "token-accuracy >= 0.95 and latency < 350ms"
  - name: distilled-v1
    accept_if: "toxicity < 0.02 and perplexity_delta <= 5%"
  - name: degrade-response
    accept_if: "user-notice = true"
```
Jonas (Eng): nice. also add KV cache cold-start behavior: measure first-token latency separately and allow higher p99 for first token during scale-up window.
Elaine (PM): acceptance criteria for launch: 1) hosted default p99 <= 350ms for baseline seq len, 2) error budget burn <= 2%/week, 3) fallback chain exercised in canary with no quality regressions. thumbs if ok. :thumbsup:
Sam (CS): thumbs. also request a customer-facing note on graceful degradation semantics for docs. i'll draft.
Priya (Sales): thumbs, but we need a clear pricing appendix for dedicated SLA. sync with finance tomorrow.
Maria (SRE): one more ops detail: define SLO alerting thresholds: page if error budget burn > 80% in 1h or p99 > 2x target for 30m. otherwise create sev2 ticket.
Jonas (Eng): agree. implementation notes: prefer circuit-breaker style for fallbacks instead of immediate switch to degraded responses. smoother transitions reduce surprises.
Keiko (ML Eng): we'll add an automated eval harness to run prompt sets against fallback models during canary so we can catch regressions.
Elaine (PM): ok action items: Jonas -> implementation plan + cost estimate, Maria -> alert runbook + burn thresholds, Keiko -> fallback acceptance tests, Sam -> customer doc, Priya -> pricing/contract wording. deploy-bot will post canary when ready.
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled at 2024-11-04T15:30Z for canary group alpha.
Sam (CS): noted. I'll prep the customer note for alpha customers.
Jonas (Eng): will have a rough plan by EOD. if anyone has hard constraints (latency or quality) drop them here now.
Elaine (PM): thanks all — we'll iterate PRD quickly. main negotiable knobs: p99 target, error budget %, and if SLA requires dedicated. try to surface any blockers before EOD. :sparkles:
